name: Wanderlight
description: The Wanderlight was an MPO-1400 Purgill-class star cruiser and sister ship to the Halcyon. It was constructed at the Santhe Shipyards on the planet Corellia. In 230 BBY, the Jedi Padawans Ram Jomaram and Reath Silas visited the ship while they were on Corellia. During a battle against the Nihil pirates at that time, the marauders attempted to steal the Wanderlight and the other starcruisers under construction, which were intended to be used in assisting the destruction of Starlight Beacon. However, the theft was foiled. By the time of the First Order-Resistance War, the Wanderlight was one of five Purgill-class starcruisers still in operation, alongside the Halcyon, the Idyll, the Sojourn, and the Sterling.
